title: Japan Postal Code & Address Normalizer
description: Give postal codes (7 digits) and/or addresses; each item returns one result row (and one charge). Input errors are free.

items.title: Postal codes or addresses
items.description: Postal codes (100-0001, 〒1000001, １００−０００１) and/or addresses (東京都千代田区飯田橋1-2-3). Up to 100,000 items per run.
prefill: 東京都千代田区飯田橋1-2-3
北海道札幌市中央区大通西二十丁目

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Auto (7 digits = postal code, otherwise address)
mode.description: Auto picks per item. 'address' returns the postal code with a confidence level: town (exact town and block range), city (only the city's general code), ambiguous (several codes, candidates listed), none.
